notes.title: Garden / Irrigation
notes.body: Decision: water the raised beds at dawn on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Rationale: lower evaporation. The rain-sensor option is still tentative.

notes.title: Mira / Drinks
notes.body: Sender 101 (Mira) prefers decaffeinated coffee after 14:00 and dislikes oat milk.

notes.title: Jonas / Cycling
notes.body: Sender 202 (Jonas) uses the blue cargo bike, nicknamed Blitz, for nursery pickup.

notes.title: Heat pump
notes.body: The heat pump is a Vaillant aroTHERM plus. The indoor unit is in the cellar. Service is due in November 2026.

notes.title: School contacts
notes.body: The after-school programme is abbreviated OGS. Pickup changes must be sent before 11:30.

notes.title: Recycling
notes.body: Gelbe Tonne collection is every second Thursday. Glass goes to the containers near Lindenplatz.

notes.title: Guest room
notes.body: The Wi-Fi QR card is in the top drawer of the guest-room desk. Do not store the Wi-Fi password in memory.

notes.title: Vet / Nori
notes.body: Nori is the cat. The regular veterinary clinic is Tierarztpraxis am Park; carrier size is medium.

notes.title: Holiday / Bretagne
notes.body: Confirmed: travel by train to Brittany on 18 July 2027. Open question: Rennes or Saint-Malo for the final three nights.

notes.title: Kitchen paint
notes.body: Selected colour: RAL 9010. Rationale: it matches the existing cabinet fronts. Buying paint is not yet scheduled.

notes.title: Babysitter
notes.body: Lea is usually available Tuesday evenings. Ask at least three days ahead; availability is not guaranteed.

notes.title: Groceries
notes.body: For pasta, the household usually buys whole-wheat penne. Mira's gluten-free food is a separate requirement.
